summary: Senmiao Technology filed an 8-K to disclose a private placement of up to 10,000,000 units at $1.10 each, each unit comprising one common share and four warrants exercisable at $1.46 per share, for gross proceeds of ~$11M. The offering is exempt under Regulation D, limited to accredited/sophisticated investors. Proceeds will fund working capital. Closing requires stockholder approval. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation; no strategic shift, takeover, or restructuring is involved.
